<function name="SetPhysicsPaused" parent="physenv" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Pauses or unpauses the physics simulation globally. See <page>physenv.GetPhysicsPaused</page> for the getter.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<added>2024.12.12</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="pause" type="boolean">`true` to pause, `false` to unpause.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
